run_visualize_graph: run the visualize_graph script to generate PDF visualizations of graph-text pairs from a dataset
run_graph_to_dot: run graph_to_dot to convert a GraphTextPair into a Graphviz dot format string
run_format_label: run format_label to normalize, truncate, and HTML-escape a node or edge label for dot output
run_truncate: run truncate to shorten a string to a configurable maximum length with ellipsis
run_visualize_graph_cli: run the CLI tool with graph_ids and layout flags to visualize specific graphs as PDFs
